scope: Static text-only review of the closed v2 delta to original oracle findings. No product execution/import, syntax parser, typecheck, tests, database, network, R edits or source-proposal writes.
conclusion: No new blocking finding in the reviewed v2 delta. Original Q1 and Q2 are closed statically within the explicit externally reviewed default FINANCIAL profile. Runtime acceptance remains unmeasured by this reviewer.

findings.original: Signed request-authored quorum could differ from the actual signed FINANCIAL policy strength.
findings.reason: loadInputs requires a valid external approval-policy hash and the exact finite two-approval, distinct-user, unique OWNER/AUDITOR role-set, ten-minute profile. Authorization first verifies each actual signed policy file and its record digest, then requires the approval-policy digest to equal that independently reviewed external hash. Each signed request must match every fixed rule field and exact TTL. Real signed decisions, request-binding digest, consume identity/timing, allowed roles and distinct approving user IDs are still independently checked and recounted. The CONSUMED product shortcut remains unused.
findings.prerequisite: The operator must capture and review the exact default policy bytes before any deliberately weaker overwrite. Automatically pinning the current weaker policy would violate the documented external trust contract; the fixed rule still refuses a one-vote request. No generic YAML policy inference or protected approval source change is introduced.

findings.original: bodyFields permitted repeated allowed names and did not establish exact cardinality.
findings.reason: paymentBody still validates the normalized allowed body shape. bodyFields must now be an array of strings with Set cardinality equal to its array length and sorted canonical equality to all actual normalized body keys. This enforces exact key membership and cardinality while retaining completeness, positive safe byte count, raw hash format and normalized body digest checks.
findings.limit: The verifier does not reconstruct raw wire bytes or prove absence of duplicate keys before provider JSON parsing. The existing evidence scope explicitly retains this boundary.

additionalDelta.assessment: Exactly decision, terminalReceiptState, posts and commits are accepted. Count objects have only one own key and a nonnegative safe-integer exact value. Decision must equal a supported terminal receipt state. Extra expected fields, obsolete conflated-hash literals and contradictory states fail loadInputs before coldVerifier is called. The outer catch sets inputs false; all other absent mandatory checks are then filled false, preventing vacuous pass.

Current default FINANCIAL rule is requiredApprovals 2, rolesAllowed OWNER/AUDITOR, requireDistinctUsers true and ttlMinutes 10. No claim is made that all custom stronger/other policy profiles are supported.

The delta leaves actual commit selection, three-digest mapping, signed request/decision/consumption verification, consumed-before-start ordering, ledger-v2/action-chain separation, path anchors, snapshots and child lifecycle code unchanged. Original review limits remain applicable.

knownLimits.assessment: Current request creation reads Date.now separately for createdTs and expiresTs. A clock tick or other clock drift between those calls can produce a lifetime differing from exactly 600000 ms; v2 intentionally refuses it. This is a disclosed potential false-refusal/fixture compatibility failure, not an authority bypass. No grace, retry, source fix, actual timing measurement or waived failure is inferred.

The manifest remains operator-trusted outside verified workspace/provider roots. A file hash and fixed tuple are finite reviewed authority anchors, not same-UID isolation, automatic arbitrary-policy semantics or proof that an operator chose honest anchors.

Root has described forthcoming genuine signed one-vote and unsupported-expected controls. This review did not read active test drafts or claim either control executed. Actual cold CLI, lifecycle, malformed-input and genuine positive results remain for the sole root runner.
This is a static delta review only. It does not qualify the full F01-F38 corpus, control results, Node24/Linux, complete transitive dependencies or formal P1-19 Done.
